function.description: Author your own durable SKILLS (procedures you can reload in future sessions). create: a new SKILL.md (markdown, a # heading) plus when = the index line that says when to load it (<= 60 chars). patch: exact-string replace. edit: replace the whole body. delete: archive. patch/edit/delete need expected_sha256 = the sha256 load_skill returned for the body you read. rollback: restore an archived revision (to_sha, default the one the last change replaced). A background delete names absorbed_into. promote is owner-only. New and edited skills wait for review before they activate; a bundled skill's fix waits for the owner.
function.name: skill_manage
